prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [choose_path, redesign] choose_path_split_redesign: Redesign the choose_path screen into a split layout clearly separating ready-to-adopt preset pets from custom pet generation.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Choose Your Pet Experience", "body": "Select a pre-made pet for instant play or build a custom companion from your photos."}}
1: [sign_in, reorder] sign_in_reorder_early: Move sign_in to immediately follow the initial story screen before choosing a pet path.
   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Create Account to Save Your Pet", "body": "Sign in first so your desktop pet and settings sync seamlessly across sessions."}, "_order": ["story", "sign_in", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
2: [home, new_flow] interactive_waiting_flow: Add an interactive waiting room sub-flow with mini-games while the desktop pet is generating in the background.
   config: {"waiting": {"headline": "Your Pet is Being Created!", "body": "Play a quick mini-game while your desktop companion gets ready."}, "new_waiting_game": {"headline": "Pet Playground", "body": "Practice feeding and playing with virtual toys while generation completes.", "layout": "card"}, "_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_waiting_game", "home_intro"]}
3: [finish, new_screen] pet_shortcut_guide_screen: Insert a dedicated hotkey and system tray control guide screen right before finishing onboarding.
   config: {"new_controls_overview": {"headline": "How to Control Your Desktop Pet", "body": "Use Ctrl+Pet to open commands, or right-click the system tray icon to hide or summon your pet anytime.", "layout": "centered", "button_label": "Got It, Let's Go!"}, "_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro", "new_controls_overview"]}
4: [sign_in, hint] sign_in_progress_sync_hint: Add a prominent explanatory hint explaining that signing in protects pets from being lost or reset.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Signing in backs up your pet traits so you never lose your companion when reopening the desktop app."}}
5: [home, wait_info] waiting_time_estimate_info: Display an estimated progress timer and active status updates on the waiting screen.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_time_estimate": true, "show_progress": true, "hint": "Pet synthesis typically takes 2-3 minutes. You can minimize this window."}}
6: [adoption, incentive] adoption_starter_incentive: Highlight bonus starter accessories included when completing the pet adoption process.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Includes Starter Accessory Pack!", "style": "playful"}]}}
7: [home, notification] waiting_desktop_ready_notification: Add an option to send a OS desktop notification when pet generation completes in the background.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "hint": "We will notify you on your desktop as soon as your pet is ready to join you."}}
8: [finish, layout] home_intro_spotlight_layout: Switch the home_intro screen to a spotlight layout focused on activating the pet on the desktop.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "spotlight", "headline": "Meet Your New Desktop Companion", "button_label": "Summon Pet to Desktop"}}
9: [adoption, copy] upload_photos_guidance_copy: Update photo upload body text with clearer formatting requirements to prevent rendering glitches.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"headline": "Upload Clear Pet Photos", "body": "For best results, upload well-lit photos facing forward without background clutter.", "hint": "Supported formats: PNG, JPG under 10MB."}}

verdicts.reason: Redesign retains both preset adoption and custom creation options without breaking any base rules.
Reordering sign_in inside onboarding is explicitly allowed and preserves all required steps and jobs.
Adding an interactive waiting sub-flow is permitted inside onboarding as long as waiting information and required steps are preserved.
Adding a controls guide screen after home_intro is explicitly allowed under Rule 4.
Adding explanatory hint text to sign_in is allowed and breaks no rules.
Time estimate and progress updates during a real wait are explicitly allowed.
Onboarding copy mentions a bonus starter accessory pack, violating Rule 3 prohibition on mentioning gifts or free extras.
Adding a desktop ready notification option during waiting is explicitly allowed under Rule 4.
Redesigning the home_intro layout inside onboarding is allowed.
Updating guidance copy on the photo upload screen breaks no rules.
